children: Clint Hurt, a Director, reported a direct sale of 6,000 shares of common stock on September 8, 2026. The shares were sold at $220.44 per share. The total sale amount reported was $1,322,640. Following the transaction, Mr. Hurt directly owns 73,937 shares of common stock, which includes 300 direct shares and 73,637 indirect shares held of record by Clint Hurt and Associates.
